name: Knowledge weekly
description: Every Sunday at 18:00 Dubai the Knowledge Editor writes the CBO's weekly Knowledge Watch digest from the items filed since the last one: headlines, one section per knowledge category, and what to watch next week. It is filed on the Knowledge Watch screen and as a note in the vault. The digest is the run's result: set who receives it, by chat and by mail, on the plugin's Settings page.

steps.name: Write the week's digest
steps.description: The Knowledge Editor writes the digest from what the plugin gathers and files it through the plugin.
steps.instruction: Follow the knowledge-digest Skill: call `knowledge_watch_digest_facts`, write each section it lists, and file the digest with `knowledge_watch_save_digest`. Write nothing any other way and send nothing yourself. Your last reply is delivered as the digest: reply with exactly the markdown the save answered, and nothing else. When there are no items, save nothing and reply with exactly NOTHING, so nothing is sent.
